'''Jornhill''' is a town in [[Andor]]. It is located on the northern border, near [[Kore Springs]].

When the hearing in Kore Springs is held for [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]] and [[Min Farshaw]], [[Maigan Nem]] wants the three of them "ridden out of town on a rail" all of the way to Jornhill.{{ref/book|5|1}}
